2607.11493.title: Agentic Skill Optimization over Lie Algebroids
2607.11493.paper_summary: Agentic systems increasingly improve themselves by editing skills: prompts, rubrics, plans, tool contracts, examples, validators, and traces. Skill edits are not independent coordinates in a vector space: they are local repairs to structured artifacts whose effects are observed only after rollout, validation, and critique. Distinct edits can have the same immediate visible effect while differing in routing context, template state, guardrail scope, or future composability. The order of edits can matter as well: repairing a schema before a normalization rule need not be equivalent to applying the same edits in the reverse order. This paper introduces a new framework for skill optimization called LASKO, for Lie Algebroid SKill Optimization. LASKO models typed, anchored Markdown skills as the base category and available edit policies as sections of a controlled Lie algebroid with anchor $ρ$. The anchor maps an edit policy to its visible Markdown effect; the kernel $\ker(ρ)$ represents latent template, routing, or implementation structure; and the algebroid bracket measures noncommuting edit composition. As shown in the paper, LASKO achieves order-of-magnitude speedups in skill optimization in our preliminary benchmark results, primarily because it substitutes inexpensive Lie-bracket screening tests that run in microseconds, before investing in expensive validations that require running large language models. On a causal extraction from natural language task, LASKO achieved a speedup of almost $15 \times$ compared to a brute-force approach that validated all edits by running them through a DeepSeek V3.1 4-bit model with 671B parameters.
2607.11493.paper_summary_zh: 代理系統越來越多地通過編輯技能來自我改進：提示、評分標準、計劃、工具合約、範例、驗證者和痕跡。技能編輯並不是向量空間中的獨立坐標：它們是對結構化工件的局部修復，其效果僅在推出、驗證和評價後才能觀察到。不同的編輯可能會產生相同的立即可見效果，但在路由上下文、模板狀態、護欄範圍或未來可組合性方面有所不同。編輯的順序也可能很重要：在應用標準化規則之前修復架構不一定等同於以相反順序應用相同的編輯。本文介紹了一種新的技能優化框架，稱為 LASKO，即 Lie Algebroid SKill Optimization。LASKO 將類型化、固定的 Markdown 技能建模為基本類別，並將可用的編輯政策建模為受控 Lie 代數的部分，帶有錨點 $ρ$。錨點將編輯政策映射到其可見的 Markdown 效果；核 $\ker(ρ)$ 表示潛在的模板、路由或實施結構；而代數括號則衡量不交換的編輯組合。正如本文所示，LASKO 在我們的初步基準結果中實現了技能優化的數量級加速，主要是因為它用在微秒內運行的廉價 Lie 括號篩選測試替代了需要運行大型語言模型的昂貴驗證。在從自然語言任務中進行的因果提取中，LASKO 相較於通過 DeepSeek V3.1 4 位模型（擁有 671B 參數）驗證所有編輯的暴力方法，實現了近 $15 \times$ 的加速。
